chapter: Lincoln Park and the name Kid
title: How the girls dressed at Lulu White's
summary: Ory describes the women in robes and house clothes.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Was she bowling at that time or playing like this? Do you remember? Mostly picking. Mostly picking. Bought a little bit. Were you in Little White's very much? Mm-hmm. How did those girls dress?
Oh, they changed clothes every minute. They didn't have much clothes, you know. What did... Just changed their gown like, you know. In Lulu's?
Just a sort of chemise or something like that? Well, tell them, did they dress a lot? Did they dress in fancy clothes sometimes?
I never did see them on the street, you know. No, no, I mean inside, in the house.

Or the negligee and the robe and things, you know. Mm-hmm. They get house clothes, you know. I mean... But they weren't all dressed up. Oh, no, not in... No? No, not in evening gowns or things like that. No, no, yeah. They were upstairs. When the guys walk in, they come in down like race horses. Mm-hmm.
